instruction: I've received a request from my friend who asked for assistance in editing an image. The document with the requirements and the picture to be adjusted are on the Desktop. Please convert the image to grayscale (black and white) and save the edited picture as "pic.jpg" on the Desktop. Thank you!

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting image to grayscale. Created custom metric check_grayscale__ade1ce93 to verify the output image has equal RGB channels (grayscale) or is in grayscale mode.

llm_judge_reasons: Custom metric check_grayscale__ade1ce93 correctly verifies grayscale conversion by checking if image mode is grayscale (L/LA) or if RGB channels are approximately equal
Complete coverage: verifies both requirements (grayscale conversion and file saved as pic.jpg on Desktop)
Robust implementation with proper edge case handling (None values, different image modes, exception handling)
Data flow is correct: vm_file getter retrieves the output file, metric analyzes it using PIL/numpy
Tolerance of 5 in RGB comparison appropriately handles minor variations in grayscale conversion
No UI state dependencies, simple postconfig is sufficient for file-based verification
